title: How the Enrollment Type Affects Transportation and Continuing Placements
content:
The enrollment type a student holds under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions changes what other district programs owe the student.

**Transportation.** When the type is not eligible for regular district bus service, the student is not eligible for regular district bus service to the campus attended, whatever the distance, and the family provides transportation. A Choice Program Enrollment student instead qualifies for the choice program hub shuttle, because that type qualifies for the hub shuttle.

**Continuing a placement.**
- A placement whose term runs through the campus's highest grade continues each following school year at the same campus without a new request, and the returning-student registration keeps the type.
- A placement whose term is a single school year (renewal required every year) needs a newly approved request for every school year; without one, the student is registered on Attendance Zone Enrollment at the zoned campus.
- A student moving to the next campus level (elementary to middle school, middle school to high school) returns to the zoned campus of the new level unless a new request is approved.
- A change of residence within the district changes the zoned campus but does not end an approved placement.

## Applying the rules to the next school year

| Placement held this year | Next school year, same campus level, no new request | Moving to the next campus level, no new request |
|---|---|---|
| term through the campus's highest grade | continues at the same campus on the same type | returns to the zoned campus of the new level |
| term of a single school year | registered on Attendance Zone Enrollment at the zoned campus | returns to the zoned campus of the new level |

## Examples (hypothetical)

- A family on a placement whose term runs through the campus's highest grade moves to another address inside the district during the year. The zoned campus changes; the placement continues.
- A fifth-grader on a choice placement at an elementary campus moves up to middle school. Without a newly approved request, the student returns to the zoned middle school.
